Dehydrated Kasuri Methi Supplier in India for Food Brands

Kasuri methi, or dried fenugreek leaves, gives butter chicken, dal, parathas and curry blends their familiar savory, slightly bitter note. Importers, spice blenders and ready-meal makers who need a steady dehydrated kasuri methi supplier India can source it from Tradenest Naturals in Surat. As a kasuri methi exporter, we supply dehydrated leaves with a clear green color and a strong, true aroma. Every lot is checked against an agreed specification, so your recipes taste the same from one order to the next. We work as a dry fenugreek leaves supplier as well as an exporter. Fresh leaves are dehydrated under controlled conditions to hold their color and aroma. Careful sorting and cleaning removes stems and foreign matter before packing. Whether you need bulk dehydrated fenugreek leaves for production or wholesale kasuri methi for distribution, we can plan supply around your volumes.

Sourcing and Processing Methods

Raw material is carefully selected and sourced from trusted growers in India. Our team checks the leaves for maturity, color and freshness before they enter processing. Approved leaves are washed in clean water and then dehydrated at controlled temperatures. This process keeps the bitter-sweet flavor that chefs expect from kasuri methi. We screen the dried material in several stages to keep leaf size even and to remove stems. The finished product is offered as whole leaves or crushed flakes. As a B2B dried kasuri methi supplier, we keep batch records so each shipment can be traced.

Quality Standards and Technical Specifications

Buyers often ask: What quality documents do you provide? Tradenest Naturals is an FSSAI registered food business and an IEC registered exporter. A product specification sheet is shared with every quotation. Third-party lab testing can be arranged on request at the buyer's cost. Buyers also ask: What are the typical specifications? Our dehydrated kasuri methi is supplied as whole leaves or crushed flakes, with moisture below 8.0%. Shelf life is 24 months in sealed packaging. The standard product has no added colors or preservatives. The clean leaf works well in seasoning blends, spice mixes and ready-to-eat meals.

Packaging and Export Support

Clients frequently ask: What are the packaging and shelf-life options? We pack dried fenugreek leaves in food-grade, moisture-barrier materials. Options include multi-wall paper bags, HDPE drums and sealed poly pouches. These protect the leaves from humidity and light in transit. Shelf life is 24 months when stored sealed in a cool, dry place. For a dehydrated kasuri methi bulk buy, we offer pack sizes from 1 kg retail packs to 25 kg export cartons. Our team provides export documentation support for customs clearance. Because we keep our supply chain simple, we can offer a fair dehydrated kasuri methi price to our buyers.

Applications Across Food Industries

Kasuri methi is a key ingredient in many Indian and South Asian dishes. Food processors use it in gravies, curries, parathas and snack seasonings. Snack makers blend the crushed leaves into namkeen, chips and extruded snacks for an herbal note. Ready-to-cook brands use it to recreate restaurant-style flavor at scale. Spice blenders also add the leaves to curry powders and tandoori rubs. Restaurants, cloud kitchens and FMCG brands buy it for its versatility. Our team can help your product developers choose between whole leaves and crushed flakes.

Partner With Tradenest Naturals

You might wonder: What is the minimum order quantity for dehydrated kasuri methi? Our MOQ is 5 Kg, which suits new brands and trial orders. Clients also ask: What is the lead time, and how do I request a sample or quote? Lead time depends on destination and order volume, and we confirm it with each quotation. Samples are available on request, so you can check the aroma and color yourself. Contact our sales team to discuss your requirements, OEM and private label packing, or wholesale pricing. Tradenest Naturals ships worldwide from India.
